description: Pressure Swing Adsorption simplified semi-empirical model: recovery, purity, and specific energy
source: Sircar & Golden (2000) Sep. Sci. Technol.; Yang (1987) Gas Separation by Adsorption Processes; DOE Hydrogen Program

psa_unit.note: Representative industrial PSA unit for H2 purification

feed_pressure_ref_bar.note: Reference feed pressure for nominal performance

product_pressure_bar.note: Product (H2-rich) side pressure; PSA operates near feed pressure

feed_h2_fraction_nominal.note: Typical H2 fraction in SMR reformate feed. Sircar & Golden 2000

recovery_nominal.note: Nominal H2 recovery (fraction of feed H2 recovered as product). Sircar & Golden 2000: 70-90%

purity_nominal.note: Nominal product purity (99.99%). DOE H2 fuel quality standard

specific_energy_kWh_per_kg_H2.note: Specific electric energy consumption at nominal conditions. DOE: 1-3 kWh/kg H2

recovery_pressure_exponent.note: Recovery scales as (P_feed/P_ref)^exponent. Higher pressure improves recovery.

recovery_feed_h2_coefficient.note: Recovery linear dependence on feed H2 fraction: eta_rec = eta_nom * (1 + coeff*(y_H2 - y_nom))

energy_pressure_factor.note: Pressure exponent for W = W_nom * (P_ref/P)^gamma. Higher P => lower W. Fitted to Sircar & Golden (2000) operating curves.
